---
name: Agent task
about: A change for a coding agent to make and test
---

## Context
Why this change exists. Link the docs it depends on, and say to stop and ask if the issue and docs differ.

## Task
What to build or change, as numbered items. Name the exact files.

## Constraints
Dependencies allowed, network access, data that must not be created or changed, and files that must not be edited.

## Tests
Test framework, where tests live, and how each expected value must be derived.

## Stop and ask
Decisions the agent must not make. Write "None" if there are none.

## Acceptance
The exact command to run, and what the pull request must state.
